chapter: Chicago, Lee Collins and the road
title: Lee Collins's band and the Illinois Central excursion to Chicago
summary: Lee Collins's band, Danny's first, went on the weekend excursion train from New Orleans to Chicago for Professor Cook.

story.theme_name: Chicago: the jazz migration and its clubs
story.community_name: Going north: working the Chicago jazz scene

blocks.x: Well, what's the first band you came up to Chicago to work with? You had worked with Lee Collins down in New Orleans.
That was the first band, Lee Collins.
Where did you all get(?) the excursion?

The excursion came up... Like, they used to have an excursion from New Orleans and other parts on the I.C. It was nine hundred miles from New Orleans to Chicago, and they would give you weekend excursions to Chicago at a

cut rate. And people would pack the trains, and go and spend, like, maybe a week up there. You'd get there... Leave on a Sunday and you'd get there Monday, and you'd stay over that week, and come back the following the week. And they used to bring a band most of the times. There would be a reunion of some kind.
Was the excursion on the train or the boat?

Yeah! On the IC. And we'd meet at Canal Street, and I went... Lee said, "We've got a chance to go to Chicago." I'm working with that band. He said, "We've got a chance to go to Chicago. Professor Cook is promoting it."
